newsitem.title: UK: BAe declines to comment on Thomson bid news.
newsitem.headline: BAe declines to comment on Thomson bid news.

text.p: British Aerospace Plc declined to comment on Wednesday on the chances of creating a giant new Anglo-French missile group now that France has picked Lagardere as preferred bidder for Thomson SA.
BAe said it would be premature to comment, noting the French government still has to make a final decision on whether it sells Thomson to Lagardere or to rival suitor Alcatel Alsthom SA.
"I don't think its appropriate to comment at this stage. We have got to wait and see how the process develops," said a company spokesman.

BAe and Lagardere are merging their guided missile businesses to create Matra BAe Dynamics, which they say will rank as Europe's largest guided weapons business, with annual sales of a billion stg and a workforce of 6,000.

But BAe and Lagardere issued a statement in August, which said they had signed an agreement that if Lagardere succeeds in taking over Thomson then "Matra BAe Dynamics would become a joint venture between Thomson-Matra and British Aerospace, which would include the relevant guided weapon businesses of Thomson..."
